# Cults

Cults is a digital marketplace for 3D printing models, offering a platform for designers to share and sell their creations.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cults/.

## Actions

- **Cults GraphQL POST**: Execute a GraphQL operation against the Cults API.
- **Get Approved Origins** (read-only): Retrieve approved sharing origins from Cults.
- **Share on Create (FR)** (read-only): Prefill a new creation on Cults (French locale).
